mLocKeys.keySummary: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and desecrates the ground for @GroundDuration@ seconds, <status>Slowing</status> enemies by @SlowPercent*-100@% and applying @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
When Varus kills an enemy, he gains @MinionAS@ Attack Speed, @MinionAD@ Attack Damage, and @MinionAP@ Ability Power for @ASDuration@ seconds.

Champion takedowns grant @ChampionAS@ Attack Speed that can bypass the Attack Speed cap, @ChampionAD@ Attack Damage, and @ChampionAP@ Ability Power instead.
Varus has increased Attack Speed after killing an enemy.
Varus has increased Attack Speed after killing an enemy.

mBuff.mDescription: Varus is readying a powerful shot.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Varus is readying a powerful shot.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@%. After @MaxChannelDuration@ seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund @ManaRefund*100@% of its Mana cost.

Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing @TotalDamageMinTooltip@ physical damage, reduced by @FalloffPercent*100@% per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent*100@%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to @MaxChargeAmp*100@% based on charge time (maximum @TotalDamageMax@) .

mLocKeys.keySummary: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for @RootDuration@ seconds and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. Rooted enemies gain @PassiveStacks@ Blight stacks over the duration.

The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root.

<titleLeft>Chain of Corruption</titleLeft><mainText>This unit must move away from the approaching corruption to avoid being bound in place.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Blighted Quiver</titleLeft><mainText>Varus' attacks deal additional magic damage and apply Blight.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage and apply a Blight stack for @DebuffDuration@ seconds (max @MaxStacks@ stacks).

Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing @PercentHPPerStack@ max Health magic damage per stack (max @MaxPercentHPPerStack@ max Health damage). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by @CDRPerBlightStack*100@% of their Maximum per stack.

Active: Varus' next {{Spell_VarusQ_Name}} deals an additional @QEmpowerPercentHP@ missing Health magic damage, increased up to @MaxQEmpowerPercentHP@ missing Health damage based on charge time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Passive damage from <keywordMajor>Blight</keywordMajor> detonations is capped at @MaxMonsterDamage@ damage per stack against jungle monsters.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Blight</titleLeft><mainText>Varus' abilities deal extra damage to this unit.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
